title: “Owls are wise and foxes are unfaithful”: Uncovering animal stereotypes in vision-language models
reasoning: The paper focuses on investigating and mitigating cultural stereotypes and behavioral tropes associated with animals (such as 'wise' owls or 'unfaithful' foxes) in vision-language models. While it uses moral descriptors like 'loyal' or 'unfaithful' to characterize these animal stereotypes, it does not evaluate or benchmark human religion, faith, or ethical/moral systems.
